notes.title: First Fix of the EA
notes.content:
In relation to your requests; The camera has been adjusted and refocused on the character you can now move it more smoothly and it does not collide with the scenery anymore.

For the fix to come:
-Level Design Issue that makes you dodge a lot of enemy
- And it is planned to rework the final boss of the first level to make it more interesting in his mechanics and we will give him a real staging at the beginning and at the end of the fight

Tell us about your returns, please
